run_webhook_sync: run a single webhook synchronously for a given action with optional payload data
emit_webhooks_sync: emit all active webhooks for an organization and project filtered by action name
emit_webhooks_for_instance_sync: emit webhooks for an action using model instances as payload with optional batching
api_webhook: decorate an APIView post, put, or patch method to emit webhooks after successful responses
get_nested_field: retrieve a nested field from a single object or list of objects using dot-separated path
